name: Editor
description: Edits rich text with formatting, autosave, and a word count.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/react
dependencies.reason: Optional — enables rich-text mode; without TipTap the editor falls back to a markdown textarea.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/starter-kit
dependencies.reason: Optional — TipTap extension bundle used by rich-text mode.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/extension-link
dependencies.reason: Optional — link formatting in rich-text mode.

label.description: Visible label above the field; names the text box

helperText.description: Helper text below the field; describes the text box

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid: the danger edge, aria-invalid and the error message

errorMessage.description: Words shown under the field while invalid, with a warning icon

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when empty; never the accessible name

disabled.description: Disable the editor; the text stays selectable and copyable

readOnly.description: Read-only: the toolbar hides and the edge turns dashed

formats.description: Which format buttons the default toolbar shows (one heading step: `heading`)

statusBar.description: Show the default status bar. On by default only when maxLength or onAutoSave is set

onAutoSave.description: Auto-save callback, called at autoSaveInterval (may be async)

rows.description: Height of the writing area in text lines, as Textarea counts them

maxLength.description: Maximum character count. The status bar shows count / limit, warns at 90% and says how many over past it

when: Text that needs formatting controls beside it
Drafts that autosave and report a word count
whenNot: Chat or AI prompt input (use Prompt)
guidelines: Compose Editor.Toolbar and Editor.Content to control toolbar layout; split groups with a vertical Separator
Without TipTap it falls back to a markdown-aware textarea
Give it a label (or aria-label); the placeholder is a hint, not a name
onAutoSave may return a Promise; the status reads Saving…, Saved or Couldn’t save
rows sets the writing area height in lines
maxLength drives the counter's warning and over-limit states
heading, blockquote, orderedList, undo and redo are opt-in via formats
accessibility: Toolbar has role="toolbar" with one tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between its buttons
Format buttons use aria-pressed to indicate active state; undo and redo omit it
The label names the text box (aria-labelledby); helper and error text describe it; invalid sets aria-invalid
Status indicator uses aria-live="polite" for save status announcements
Keyboard shortcuts match standard text editor conventions (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, etc.)
Global shortcuts (e.g., Sidebar Ctrl+B) automatically yield when focus is inside the Editor
The field rings when the writing area has focus; a focused toolbar button rings itself
Disabled text stays selectable; read-only hides the toolbar

examples.name: Default
examples.description: The toolbar you get with no configuration; no status bar until there is a limit or a save.

examples.name: With Auto-Save and Publish
examples.description: Save state sits next to the primary action in the toolbar.
examples.code:
<Editor
  label="Post" placeholder="Start typing your post"
  onValueChange={(v) => console.log(v)}
>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="strikethrough" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Actions">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="saved" />
      <Button variant="solid" tone="accent" size="sm">
        Publish
      </Button>
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Save Failed
examples.description: A failed autosave says Couldn’t save in the danger ink, with an icon.
examples.code:
<Editor label="Draft" defaultValue="This draft could not be saved.">
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Status">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="error" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: The danger edge on the field and the reason below it.
examples.code: <Editor label="Post" invalid errorMessage="Write at least one line" />

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed and not editable, but the text stays selectable.
examples.code:
<Editor
  label="Post"
  defaultValue="This content cannot be edited."
  disabled
/>

examples.name: Read Only
examples.description: No toolbar and a dashed edge; text can be selected and copied, but never changed.
examples.code:
<Editor
  label="Post"
  defaultValue="This content is read-only. You can select and copy text but cannot change it."
  readOnly
/>

examples.name: Custom Toolbar
examples.description: A vertical Separator splits the controls into labelled clusters.
examples.code:
<Editor
  label="Blog post" placeholder="Write your blog post"
  onValueChange={(v) => console.log(v)}
>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Basic formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Separator orientation="vertical" length="control" />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Structure">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Status">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="saving" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Full Formatting
examples.description: Every opt-in format switched on, with a taller writing area.
examples.code:
<Editor label="Article" placeholder="Write an article" rows={16}>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="History">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="undo" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="redo" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Separator orientation="vertical" length="control" />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="heading" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="strikethrough" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Separator orientation="vertical" length="control" />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Block formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="orderedList" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="blockquote" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: With Character Limit
examples.description: The counter warns near 280 characters and says how many over past it.
examples.code:
<Editor
  label="Bio"
  placeholder="Say who you are in a sentence or two"
  maxLength={280}
  rows={4}
  formats={['bold', 'italic', 'link']}
/>

relations.note: Prompt is for AI/chat input; Editor is for long-form content editing
Use Textarea for simple multi-line input without formatting toolbar
Use Input for single-line text input

propsSummary: label: string - visible label, names the text box
invalid: boolean + errorMessage: string - danger edge, aria-invalid and message
disabled: boolean - not editable, text stays selectable
readOnly: boolean - prevents editing, hides the toolbar
formats: EditorFormat[] - toolbar buttons (default: 6; heading is one step)
toolbar: boolean - show default toolbar (default: true)
statusBar: boolean - show the status bar (default: only with maxLength or onAutoSave)
onAutoSave: (value: string) => void | Promise<void> - auto-save handler
rows: number - writing area height in lines (default: 8)
maxLength: number - character limit with count, warning and how many over
